text:
jordan: Heads-up — intake from Kestrel. They want an instruct-tuned build for legal summarization: 64k context, int4 quant, deterministic sampling (for auditability), and a regression run vs our hosted 13B line. Asking for prioritization and a bring-up checklist.

maya: Thanks. Do we have a committed timeline from them? SLA or throughput targets?

jordan: They want POC in ~3 weeks, production in 8 weeks if POC looks good. Throughput: 5 qps sustained per customer shard, p95 latency < 2s for short summaries (they accept longer for full-doc ops).

oliver: 3-week POC is tight but doable. My preliminary plan: 1) fast ingest + smoke run at 32k context to validate instruction-following and safety, 2) quantization sweep (int8 -> int4), 3) quality regression against baseline using our instruction-eval harness.

sabrina: Notes on infra: 64k memory footprint will push >24GB KV cache for 13B; on int4 we can squeeze but will need a larger host and tuned batching. Also we should avoid global autoscale during POC to keep results stable.

jordan: Good call. Also flagged requirement: deterministic outputs for legal audit — set sampling to greedy / top_p=0.0, temp=0.0 for the canonical route, but they still want sampling variants for exploration.

oliver: Proposed minimal onboarding checklist (draft):
```
- collect base model + instruct recipe (weights, tokenizer)
- reproducible build: seed + config snapshot
- smoke eval: 100-case instruction suite (pass/fail per-case)
- quant sweep: int8 -> int4 with per-layer fallback policy
- quality regression: rouge/bert/instr-follow delta vs hosted-13B
- latency/cost profiling at 32k and 64k
- fallback policy: if int4 drop > X delta use int8 for critical layers
- rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback
```

maya: Can you add specific gating thresholds for regressions? We should be explicit for the customer and SRE.

oliver: Suggested gates: instr-follow accuracy drop <= 1.5% absolute, rouge_l delta <= 2.0 points, latency p95 not > 1.5x baseline. If any gate fails, prevent rollout. Will instrument signal tags in the eval job.

sabrina: For quant experiments, please include a per-layer reconstruction error table and a small checklist to test hallucination rates on legal prompts. Also tag model as `private-build/kestrel` so it uses private VPC capacity.

jordan: Adding config snippet for the platform team — this will be our deploy manifest for the POC: 
```
model: kestrel-instruct-64k
base_model: os-xor-13b
quant_profile: int4_aggressive
context_window: 65536
deterministic_mode: true
rollout_plan: canary(5%),step(25%),full
eval_suite: legal-100,instr-follow-500
cost_limits: {gpu_hours: 100}
```

qa-bot: Reminder — please attach the eval datasets and a sample of edge-case prompts before the smoke run. Missing datasets will block the automated regression. :memo:

maya: Ok, priority proposed: P1 for onboarding team and eng-ml sprint next week. Jordan — can you own stakeholder comms and final sign-off criteria?

jordan: I can. I'll send the intake summary and the gating thresholds to Kestrel tomorrow. Also scheduling a triage meeting Wednesday 11am PT with SRE and infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: infra quota ok, private VPC quota reserved for kestrel-instruct-64k. :white_check_mark:

sabrina: I'll start the int4 microtests on a 32k build today and post results here. Expect initial numbers in ~12h. :eyes:

jordan: Awesome — thanks everyone. If the int4 microtests look good we can escalate to full 64k quant run.
